about_the_game:
A 4-player online party game where drinking is a death sentence, and every card you place brings you closer to the edge.

In this cursed tavern, there’s only one rule:
Don’t be the one who drinks.

Each round lasts 5 turns. On every turn, you’ll place one card into your own slot and pass the remaining hand to the player on your left.
After 5 turns, everyone has played 5 cards. The player with the highest total drinks… and is eliminated.

🧠 Plan Ahead

Victory comes from smart card placement, risk management, and keeping your score low before the hand rotates.

🃏 Jokers Stir the Chaos

Joker cards add a layer of unpredictability — flipping values, shuffling orders, or triggering strange effects. Just enough randomness to keep everyone on edge.

Each round introduces a unique drink that modifies how certain cards are scored. Some cards may double, others might not count at all.
Learn the effect, adjust your strategy, and stay sharp.

Once everyone has played their cards, hands rotate left. What you tried to avoid might come back to someone else — or you.
The highest total? Knocked out.

🐙 The Kraken Watches Silently

He says nothing. He does nothing… or so it seems. From the shadows behind the bar, he shuffles the deck, stares into your soul, and waits.
Maybe this round he just watches. Maybe not.

Fast-paced rounds. Tense decisions. Surprising eliminations.

Easy to learn. Hard to survive.
One sip — and you’re out.

🕹️ Features

  • Online and local multiplayer support for up to 4 players

  • Unique drink modifier system that changes scoring each round

  • Strategic card placement with rotating hands mechanic

  • Elimination-based gameplay: one player drinks at the end of every round

  • Joker cards that add just the right amount of unpredictability

  • Fast-paced, easy to learn, hard to master

  • Controller and keyboard support

  • In-game text and voice chat support

  • Cosmetic system: unlock new characters, outfits, and style your character

  • Bar-themed visuals, UI, and sound design for full immersion

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 GB VRAM, DirectX 10 compatible (e.g. GTX 550, Radeon HD 6670)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
